newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filipino bank robbers dump their heavy haul.
newsitem.headline: Filipino bank robbers dump their heavy haul.

text.p: Three Filipinos held up a bank north of Manila but found their loot too heavy a burden when making their getaway, police said on Monday.
The three forced their way into a local savings bank in Calumpit town on Friday after overpowering the lone security guard but could only make away with three duffle bags full of coins, police said.
Even those were dumped when they heard the blare of sirens just outside the bank.
"It was too heavy for them," one police officer in the town said.
The bank refused to say how much the coins were worth.
